description: A linked fan account is ACTIVE at the first registration if it had engagement in this many days before it
A linked fan account is LAPSED at the first registration if it had NO engagement in this many days before it
A lapsed account is REACTIVATED if it engaged again within this many months after the first registration
The month-grain version of the active window (3 calendar months of engagement) for month-end snapshots
The month-grain version of the lapsed window (6 calendar months without engagement); also the gap that ends a fan spell
RFM scores are computed over this many trailing months
Lifetime value counts expected active months up to this horizon
